Over the weekend, I tested out using Google AI Mode to get flight information and 100% of the time, the only links available within the AI Mode responses were to Google Flights. I am sure the Digital Markets Act (DMA) folks in Europe are going to like this.
Natzir pointed this out on X last week showing how 100% of the links are to Google Flights. I, too, tried it out for several destinations, and all of them- both within the United States domestically and for international flights as well- had links only to Google Flights.
